subject: general
question: Khushi went to purchase a mixer. The marked price of the mixer was ₹6,000 and 20% flat discount was offered on it by the shopkeeper. How much does Khushi have to pay for the mixer?
solution:
Given:

The marked price of the mixer is 6000

The discount on the mixer is 20%

Formula Used: 

Discount price=(MP× discount)/(100)

where MP is marked price 

discount is the discount offered by the shopkeeper

Calculations:

⇒ Cost of mixer=6000

⇒ 20% of the cost price of the mixer will be or Discounted Price=**(6000×20)/(100)=60×20=Rs. 1200**

⇒ The cost of mixer after 20% discount= total price - Discounted Price=6000-1200=Rs. 4800

∴The cost of the mixer after a 20% discount will be 4800
